name: bandit.extortion_committed_contact_movement_seed_traced_route_mcw
description: R-009 M072 strict successor: prove the overmap input-resolution seam receives the explicit keyboard-character W binding as CHOOSE_DESTINATION before confirming ordinary travel to M061's basecamp-adjacent footing and preserving it with native Save-and-Quit. No fixture data is transformed.

steps.label: post_load_preopportunity_hud
steps.abort_reason: the production-created bootstrap save did not reach the gameplay HUD

steps.label: open_overmap_for_ordinary_basecamp_travel
steps.expected_visible_fact: the standard overmap is open before selecting the known basecamp-adjacent destination

steps.label: pan_to_nearest_ordinary_route_destination
steps.expected_visible_fact: ordinary overmap cursor movement selects the nearest ordinary destination at absolute OMT (163,36,0)

steps.label: preview_ordinary_route_to_basecamp_adjacency
steps.expected_visible_fact: the current keybinding owner's explicit keyboard-character W efficient-route preview is visibly distinct before ordinary travel begins

steps.label: audit_keyboard_char_route_resolution
steps.abort_reason: the current executable did not resolve the sole source-bound keyboard-character W delivery to CHOOSE_DESTINATION before route confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the current-executable input-resolution trace records the delivered raw event and non-empty route construction before a second route command

steps.label: confirm_ordinary_route_to_basecamp_adjacency
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same keyboard-character W binding confirms ordinary travel to M061's basecamp-adjacent footing

steps.label: accept_nearest_ordinary_route_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native travel confirmation accepts the non-empty ordinary route

steps.label: ordinary_route_returned_to_hud
steps.abort_reason: the confirmed overmap route did not return to gameplay before save

steps.label: audit_player_save_before_seed_save
steps.abort_reason: the copied production-created save was absent before its ordinary save

steps.label: open_seed_full_save_prompt
steps.abort_reason: the normal Save-and-Quit confirmation was not visibly open

steps.label: audit_player_save_after_seed_save
steps.abort_reason: the native Save-and-Quit action did not update the copied player save

steps.label: audit_saved_nearest_ordinary_footing
steps.abort_reason: the saved player location was not the nearest ordinary destination reached by the traced route
steps.expected_immediate_state: the current-executable native save records player absolute OMT (163,36,0), the nearest ordinary footing proved by route construction

evidence_contract.claim: the current executable uses an observed CHOOSE_DESTINATION resolution and ordinary overmap route confirmation to reach and save the named basecamp-adjacent footing
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the harness copies a production-created save with save_transforms=[] and sends only normal overmap movement, the keybinding owner's keyboard-character W route commands, and save keys
evidence_contract.terminal: this is seed evidence only; it creates no hostile state and claims no shakedown outcome
